notes.title: English version
notes.notes:
Due to a technical problem, the English version has been temporarily removed to provide you with a more stable and pleasant version to play!

I will post new information when the English version becomes available again.

Thank you for your understanding.

Michael Pillet

notes.title: News
notes.notes:
Hello, Following the deployment of Exatron Quest Silver Dust Edition, a minor "Bug" that blocked access to the 2nd basement of the volcanic area and therefore access to the boss of the area was found.

A fix comes from being implanted.

You can from this evening, update your game to avoid getting stuck in front of you, however, if you do not have the patience to wait, you can use the CTRL key to pass the " Bug "and find yourself in front of the boss's area ...

Thanking you for your understanding, please have a good day.

Michael Pillet
Pilet Studio

notes.title: News
notes.notes:
Exatron quest is a new dungeon, new characters, new quests!

Find in the game a new soundtrack from the friendly participation of the fabulous band Silver Dust (Switzerland) and a special participation of the group Seriously Serious (Switzerland)!

New:

Legendary classes!

- Assassin
- Berseker
- Archbishop
- Gunner
- Wizard
- Crusader

Will you find the unique weapons created especially for these legendary classes!

- A treasure hunt to visit the new dungeon:

The House 21

And 2 new secret places!

So come discover or rediscover the fabulous world of Exatronia and deliver the world of the king of demons!

RPG 1 PLAYER

Available in French, English and Soon in German!

notes.title: Christmas event
notes.notes:
Hello !

I want to inform you that I am going to install a Christmas event, which will take you to an exclusive boss and obviously to get a special loot!

The event will be available from December 15, 2017 to January 2, 2018!

Good luck and the goddess is watching over you!

notes.title: Bug Suite
notes.notes:
Je me suis rendu compte que suite à mon contrôle de qualité,  qu'il y avait un bug majeur...

Donc pour corriger cela, j'ai désinstallé des modules et je me suis aperçu que cela avait affecté certaines de mes  sauvegardes.

De ce fait, il se peut que les vôtres aussi.

Exemple : 

vos personnages se retrouvent sans armes et quand vous souhaitez les équiper et cela fera bugger votre partie.

Aussi, je vous demande de bien vouloir recommencer une partie au tout début, j'en suis le premier désolé...

Merci pour votre compréhension.

Michaël Pillet
Pillet Studio
